changes.title: Opening zoom
items: The new opening, step two (?opening=chart): choosing home on the sea chart flies on over the forest and into the treehouse, and she wakes in her bedroom beside her bed

changes.title: Opening chart
items: The new opening, step one (try it with ?opening=chart): the game starts on the sea chart, with only home to sail to in a first game, and What's new and Options in its corner

changes.title: Sail on
items: Sailing to another island no longer reloads the page: the music fades to the sound of the sea while you cross
After sailing, the browser's Back button opens the pause menu instead of leaving the game
Play again, A new forest and sleeping in the bed start the next night without reloading the page too, and the Sea chart buttons open the chart over the game
